summary_en: The driver has used the Air EV since 2023. Their father chose the vehicle and seller, handled the transaction and financed it. The driver reports no personal purchase or service at Auto2000.

summary_en: The driver books, brings in, approves and pays for service; their father reimburses costs described for service or tires.

summary_en: Routine journeys including Bandung–Jatinangor worked. The driver recalled no cancellation, diversion or switch to another car in the preceding two to four weeks.
inference_boundary: Personal recall in a bounded window; a family Toyota exists, but the account does not establish it was needed or immediately available.

summary_en: The driver charges at the apartment around 30% state of charge and can rest in the unit while charging.
inference_boundary: Tariff, charger inventory, charging times and conditions elsewhere were not established.

inference_boundary: Two tasks and providers; Wuling Soekarno-Hatta is not the Auto2000 branch.

summary_en: Service quality was the decision criterion. The driver reported completed work with no unresolved return, cancellation or move to another workshop and paid upfront with family reimbursement.
inference_boundary: The file does not contain an invoice or a tested price-quality trade-off.

summary_en: The driver did not know vehicle price, down payment, installments or initial cost calculations.

summary_en: A family sale or replacement was recalled, with the father handling it.
inference_boundary: No car, appraisal, offer, price or settlement outcome confirmed.

summary_en: Family acquired a new 2024 Yaris Cross Hybrid through Auto2000 and the driver started using it in January 2025. Their father chose model and seller and handled the transaction through a longstanding relationship. The driver advised on color and model-year preference.
inference_boundary: Exact dealer branch and finance terms not confirmed; family account is not a new-to-Auto2000 conversion.

summary_en: The driver books, drops off and collects the car for currently covered routine service; the father has final authority over added work or cost.
inference_boundary: Operating the visit is distinct from buying the vehicle, approving additional work or funding it.

summary_en: On a long Jatinangor–Tasikmalaya return trip with friends, the driver chose the available Yaris and reported slower throttle response under passenger load on uphill roads.
inference_boundary: Approximate journey duration; Q03 calls the trip nonstop while Q04 describes stop decisions. No exact stop count or objective performance difference is inferred.

summary_en: Passenger needs and the ability to stop before mountain and forest stretches shaped stop decisions. Performance and fuel use broadly met expectations.
inference_boundary: No logs, fuel totals or exact route timestamps were supplied.

summary_en: Routine work at a nearby Auto2000 workshop associated with the selling dealer was booked, dropped off with a service booklet, and collected after a completion notification.
inference_boundary: Named branch, time in workshop and covered items verified by provider are unknown.

summary_en: Routine work reportedly matched expectations under the original coverage package. The father would approve additional work on technical advice; no cancellation or switch was recalled.
inference_boundary: Package name, dealer reimbursement and a completed customer-paid work item were not established.

summary_en: Reported fuel savings versus a Raize Turbo motivated the family choice; the father used a longstanding Auto2000 sales relationship. The account identifies no other vehicle actively considered for that purchase.
inference_boundary: Fuel savings and consideration set reported from the household; no independent costs or competing quote.

summary_en: Vehicle price and fuel running cost were discussed. The driver says use matched fuel savings expectations broadly, despite a fuel-price increase, and reports installments arranged for the 2024 unit.
inference_boundary: Initial cash, lender decision, financing amounts and observed savings not documented.

summary_en: The driver uses the Auto2000 WhatsApp admin to book or adjust routine service and says the task gets completed.
inference_boundary: This is a successful workflow case and does not establish channel performance at other branches.

summary_en: The driver checked marketplace and dealer prices for family vehicles and stopped after identifying a plausible range.
inference_boundary: The record does not identify a binding offer, inspected appraisal, settlement, completed trade-in or necessarily this Yaris as the vehicle priced.

summary_en: The driver identified no current ownership or service task needing improvement.

inference_boundary: Separate incidents; PLN is a general preference and is not identified as the actual Rungkut stop. Charger completion, queues, date, home charging and exact vehicle variant unknown.

summary_en: The driver reported no vehicle fault that made the car unusable and no need to switch transport to campus because it broke down.
